scripts.build: esbuild scanner-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --external:playwright --external:@axe-core/playwright --outfile=dist/scanner.js && mkdir -p dist/fonts && cp node_modules/@fontsource/funnel-display/files/funnel-display-latin-600-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/funnel-display/files/funnel-display-latin-800-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/funnel-sans/files/funnel-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/funnel-sans/files/funnel-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/funnel-sans/files/funnel-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2 dist/fonts/
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f sseo-v$npm_package_version.zip && zip -qr sseo-v$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json *.html *.css background.js lib.js ui.js panel.js dashboard.js pagereport.js report.js icons dist && echo Packaged sseo-v$npm_package_version.zip
